task.description: Set up the benchmark environment so `zig build bench` exits 0. The current issue is: BENCHMARK_SETUP_ERROR: MissingDbUrl — BPM_TEST_DB_URL is not set in the shell when running zig build bench. Ensure the environment variable is configured, likely via a .env file in the project root or by checking build.zig for how it reads the variable.
acceptance_criteria: The fix is committed (if a file change) or documented

result.summary: Added .env file fallback to bench.zig resolveDbUrl() so BPM_TEST_DB_URL (or BPM_BENCH_DB_URL / BPM_DB_URL) is read from the .env file when OS environment variables are not set. The readDotEnvValue function parses .env, handles comments, quotes, and whitespace. zig build bench now works without pre-exported env vars.
result.next_action: ORCH re-runs bench check and proceeds
